title: RFC-0014: Operator Signature Provenance and Seat Attribution Invariant
invariants: A message signed -MCB is treated as coming directly from the operator.
Seats MUST NOT append -MCB to their own status lines or tool outputs.
Seats MUST sign lines with their own seat name (e.g. [AGY-Council], [bd-agy-council-pro], [bd-agy-worker-g1]).
Use -MCB ONLY when quoting the operator verbatim, with explicit source attribution.
